name: Effective VC Radius / Largest Strongly Shattered Set (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the even-parity class $\mathcal E_n$, $\mathrm{VCR}=n-1$, while the largest strongly shattered-set size is $0$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the cube-with-apex class $\mathcal A_n$, the largest strongly shattered-set size is $n$, while $\mathrm{VCR}=1$.
proof: The even-parity and cube-with-apex calculations give unbounded gaps in the two opposite directions.
